route_summary.start_to_checkpoint: Start at x=96, run across the start runway, cross the 4-tile intro gap, climb the 1-tile first step, then reach CheckpointMid at x=1696.
route_summary.checkpoint_to_highest_platform: From CheckpointMid, continue through the combat pocket, take the 2-tile rise to the upper route entry, then use the intermediate ledge to reach the highest intended platform at tile (84, 9).
route_summary.highest_platform_to_exit: Drop from the highest platform through the final 5-tile horizontal gap sequence to the final landing, then continue to the exit gate at x=3712.
